PLEASE NOTE: I have tried my best to recreate the census information as I found it but it is always best to go back to the orginal source material for confirmation. For that reason I have included page numbers. This information was collected from a number of sessions spent perusing the census records looking for "family names" and potential "family names". While I'm fairly certain about the accuracy of the names included, some of the strings of numbers may have gotten a bit "scrambled" in the transcriptions.
